synthetic_record_shape.strategy: cycle the real canonical record/sense/search-form/relation shape, then replace IDs and all lexical strings with deterministic synthetic values
synthetic_record_shape.text_policy: preserve gloss and relation-note Unicode codepoint lengths and record structure; synthesize deterministic lemma/search-form strings by record type and part of speech; do not copy canonical lemmas, glosses, notes, or IDs into synthetic JSONL

benchmark_setup: synthetic JSONL generation and synthetic authored-decision construction are fixture preparation; the product, package, and SQLite WASM runtime measurements run on temporary synthetic builds

startup.file_cache_note: first means a fresh SQLite WASM module in a fresh process; OS disk-cache state is uncontrolled

memory.scope: benchmark Node process running the production SQLite WASM module and shared runtime SQL adapter; only one live database instance at a time

corpus_cost_wiring.fast: real session load/index plus semantic audit/topic evidence/lexical quality/full dataset validation/normalization and one shared SQLite build; fixture generation is excluded
corpus_cost_wiring.normal: shared SQLite validation plus product extension consumer
corpus_cost_wiring.deep: two independent SQLite rebuilds and byte-level reproducibility checks

fixed_level_evidence.measurement: fast and normal fixed remainders derive from exact-head PR level wall-clock minus the current-canonical corpus baseline; deep uses the exact-head ci:all non-benchmark window minus the current-canonical deep corpus baseline; remainder upper bounds are rounded up to the next millisecond
